title: Jocelyn Benson wants to raise Michigan teacher pay. Union isn’t sold on plan
summary_en: The governor-elect wants to raise minimum teacher salaries to $60,000, but one of her biggest allies — the Michigan Education Association — isn’t yet on board. Others are also raising questions.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Jocelyn Benson wants to raise Michigan teacher pay. Union isn’t sold on plan
